regions.merged_text: This time I just thought "I'll write at once." Yes, thank God, my health has adjusted itself again so that hardly feel any effects of my dose of ptomane of two months ago .... Best regards to your Father, to Jack, and all our friends, and keep pleading for God's holy guidance.
